name: split
desc:
When a [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} that is Medium or larger is subjected to lightning or slashing damage, it splits into two new [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}s if it has at least 10 Hit Points. Each new [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has Hit Points equal to half the original [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s, rounded down. New [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}s are one size smaller than the original pudding.
